{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fitted wool-blend blazer, tailored cut, knee-length hem, charcoal gray #36454F, heavy worsted wool.
Crisp cotton-poplin blouse, classic pointed collar and button-front, mid-thigh length, white #FFFFFF, poplin weave.
Slim-fit dark denim trousers, straight-leg cut, ankle length, midnight blue #0A192F, sturdy cotton twill treated for water resistance.
Waterproof leather ankle boots, rounded toe, low block heel, black #000000, full-grain leather with sealed seams.
Wool-blend scarf, loose drape style, mid-length wrap, slate gray #6c757d, thick merino wool to combat frost.

This outfit respects your wish for no open skin while ensuring you stay warm against the snowy, salted roads during your walk to work. The charcoal blazer and midnight blue trousers provide a polished neat look suitable for the office, keeping water and snow from soaking into lighter fabrics. Thick wool layers on both the coat and scarf offer necessary insulation in the frosty autumn morning without requiring an additional outer layer."}
